results.summary: This project is a video mode tester that allows experimenting with different VGA timing parameters. It provides a TinyVGA output and an SPI interface for configuring horizontal and vertical visible pixels, front porch, sync pulse, and back porch registers. The design is implemented in Verilog and requires a Tiny VGA PMOD connected to the Tiny Tapeout board. It supports setting the pixel clock to 25 MHz to produce a 640x480 @ 60 Hz test pattern.
